scope: Simulation behavior for v0.5 with all gameplay modules loaded; test arena removes scenery collision except environment compatibility test. Does not establish native browser rendering or live deployment.

tests.name: All five heroes own a fixed signature and four rankable skill paths without gear inventory
All hero Q/E/R actions have anticipation, consume resources once and delay the main release
Hero E mechanics create different persistent gameplay states
An can connect three lamps and consumes six embers to empower his cone
Linh earns eight wind stacks by moving and her next hit marks and roots the target
Kiet wall blocks hostile projectiles, earns thunder and empowers a forward thrust
HoaVi Q faults targets and repeats with code; E safely returns to checkpoint
All hero ultimates and delayed damage do not recharge themselves
Learning spends available points, caps every path at three, and level rewards add points
V0.4 saves migrate gear levels to skill points while retaining hero, relics, money and outposts
V0.5 rank and relic progress survive JSON save/restore while actions are cancelled
Death, respawn and beacon travel remove pending casts, fields and checkpoint
An awakened seal returning to the village cancels pending casts, fields and elemental allies
Exactly twenty new relics have unique ids and Vietnamese/world origin plus distinct trigger text
Kim Quy reflects once and grants a bounded shield on damage
Giong creates a noncharging bamboo strike on the fifth primary attack
Thach Sanh E roots ordinary enemies with a bounded cooldown
Chu Dong Tu rewards a fresh interaction only, including after save and restore
Son Tinh standing guard reduces the next hit and then requires cooldown
Thuy Tinh Q creates water which slows an enemy in the target area
Thuy Tinh water reacts once to fire, ice and lightning without proc recursion or R charge
Tam dash creates a temporary decoy and movement boon
An Tiem rewards every eighth defeated enemy without recursive damage
Cuoi saves one lethal hit only and preserves that use across death and respawn
Trau Cau potion adds shield and mana with one potion spent
Mjolnir sixth attack chains to at most three targets without R feedback
Aegis Q/E shield requires no existing shield, respects cooldown, and excludes R
Hermes controlled skill hit reduces dash cooldown once per window
Ariadne low-health dash adds escape invulnerability with a cooldown
Phoenix R heals and burns without earning R from the burn ticks
Ankh kills on a controlled target heal four exactly once
Wukong E schedules exactly three bounded noncharging echoes
Aladdin spending ninety mana refunds twenty-five and fires a noncharging beam
Jack interaction plants one trap per eight-second window
Cinderella counts close projectile dodges once each, ignores distant threats and empowers one Q
Duplicate mythic relics give coins instead of unbounded stacking
All relics together keep ultimate damage noncharging and field/projectile counts bounded
Seven elemental Qs all damage after release and preserve their original form while queued
Seven elemental Es implement different defenses and sustain states
Seven elemental Rs damage without self charging, including delayed sweeps and rings
Harmony requires actual hits from three distinct elements; misses and repeats do not fill it
Full stack provides environment reactions and successful interactions invoke relic hooks
New gameplay and UI source parses as UTF-8 without replacement characters
